player_prompt.intro:
Du bis Speler {player_id} ({role}) in e {num_rounds}-rondjes Matching Pennies-sjpel.
- Edere róndj, sjtub '[heads]' of '[tails]' (of '[h]', '[t]') in.
- Es duw keuze euvereenkóm mit die van din taegesjpeler, wint Speler 0 de róndj; anges es Speler 1 de róndj wint.
Antjwoord mit dien keuze in 't format '[heads]' of '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Speler 0 koos {choice0}; Speler 1 koos {choice1}. Match -> Speler 0 wint
message.round_mismatch: Speler 0 koos '{choice0}'; Speler 1 koos '{choice1}'. Mismatch -> Speler 1 wint.
